title: Hook’s Villa | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked within the exclusive TOPS’L Beach & Racquet Resort in Miramar Beach, this newly built five-bedroom, five-and-a-half-bath coastal retreat offers the perfect balance of luxury and laid-back charm. Designed with elegance and comfort in mind, the home features two expansive king suites, a spacious open-concept living area, and a gourmet kitchen outfitted with top-of-the-line Viking appliances. Every bedroom includes its own private bath, creating an elevated sense of space and privacy. For added fun, a game room with a pool table, Ping-Pong, and wet bar invites guests to unwind, while nine smart TVs throughout the home ensure entertainment is always close at hand. Hot Tub Rules. Renter is liable for any damage to hot tub including a minimum of a $75 fee if the hot tub water needs to be dumped and refilled due to guest misuse. Misuse includes but is not limited to getting any food or drinks in the hot tub, breaking glass in the hot tub, getting excessive amounts of sand in the hot tub (please rinse off or shower when coming from the beach to the hot tub), and any other use of the hot tub outside of normal use. A breach of any of the above terms may result in a forfeiture of your rights regarding this rental property, including eviction from the premises without refund.
